gf-plan.text:
Golden frames, the decisions

Chat is home. One mode, the composer always has the focus. Marker lines at every width: › you, ● agent, ▸ event, ? ask. Events inline and folded, ctrl+o opens all. No header row: one to three status rows below the composer, built from segments (state, supervisor, asks, needs_you, project, chords, hints, clock, command) under [tui.status], cut from the right.

An ask is drawn inside the composer frame. ctrl+r moves the focus between the input line and the card. n note, x dismiss, J/K card, esc input.

Chords: ctrl+g agents, ctrl+t work, ctrl+f friction, ctrl+y health, ctrl+l logs. esc or the same chord returns to Chat. ? in an empty composer opens Help. No F keys. tab is reserved for autocomplete.

Work is a wave board. Health is a check grid with the agents table. Logs gets a density strip and level colors. Friction is one list with age and seen columns. Agents gets wave progress in the pod header.

Deferred: the 80×24 forms, Logs grouped by request, autocomplete, message history, the spec and the code tasks.
